job.question: In the Q&A for an external audit RFP for a retirement system whose general ledger system is Microsoft Dynamics SL, what were the total contractual fees for the prior year (FY2021) audits?
job.expected_facts: $73,000 (Oklahoma Public Employees Retirement System, RFP 515-22-300 Q&A).
job.acceptance: $73,000 for FY2021 audits suffices; issuer/RFP number optional.

reviews.reason: The document is a 2025 actuarial-services RFP for the City of Austin Employees’ Retirement System, not the external-audit RFP Q&A described. It identifies Microsoft Dynamics GP, not SL, and gives no total contractual fees for FY2021 audits.
quotes: CITY OF AUSTIN EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT SYSTEM Request for Proposal (RFP)
Actuarial Services for an Actuarial Determined Contribution (ADC) Rate Defined Benefit Plan June 26, 2025
Microsoft Dynamics GP (Great Plains) is the accounting application used by COAERS to track all general ledger activity
